note: Triennial election of the county council, 1911: polled Wednesday 31 May 1911 in six divisions; the other fifteen were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. A candidate named Donnelly withdrew. Edward Cowdy: no party label printed in 1911. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Charlemont, 27 May 1908, printed 'U.': Northern Whig, 6 June 1908, p. 10 ("Provincial Elections: County Councils: Armagh"); candidates in the Newry Reporter, 2 May 1908, p. 10 ("Armagh County Council": the nominations); Charlemont, 28 May 1914, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1914, p. 3 ("County Council Contests"); nominations in the Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council")).
